title: Finance & Accounts Intern
description: Finance & Accounts Intern Triomics | Bengaluru | Internship (flexible duration, minimum 3 months) About Triomics Triomics is building AI-powered software to accelerate oncology clinical trials and cancer care. Backed by YC, Lightspeed, Nexus Venture Partners, General Catalyst, and Battery, we work directly with cancer centers and health systems to bring our platform into live clinical workflows. As we scale from ~50 to 100+ people, the money moving through the company grows with us: cloud and software vendors, recruiting partners, office operations, and team expenses. Keeping that flow accurate, documented, and on time is what lets the rest of the company move fast. That’s where you come in. About the Role We’re hiring a Finance & Accounts Intern to support the day-to-day financial operations of our Bengaluru team: raising purchase orders, verifying vendor invoices, tracking what we’re owed and what we owe, and keeping our books clean. You’ll work on live vendor accounts and real company spend from your first week, and own the paper trail from order to payment. This is a hands-on, detail-heavy role: part billing operator, part reconciler, part follow-up owner who makes sure pending payments actually close. What You’ll Do Prepare and manage Purchase Orders (POs) for vendors and partners, such as cloud and software providers, recruiting agencies, and office and facilities vendors, with correct amounts, terms, and approvals Create, verify, and maintain invoices and billing records, cross-checking each vendor invoice against its PO and agreed terms Track payments received and payments due to vendors and partners Reconcile payments, invoices, and outstanding balances so receivables and payables reflect reality, and trace mismatches to their source rather than patching them Follow up with vendors and partners on pending payments and invoices until they are closed Maintain daily expense records and basic bookkeeping, including team expense and reimbursement entries Keep financial records, spreadsheets, and supporting documents organised and audit-ready Assist with monthly financial reports and other routine accounting tasks Why Triomics See how finance runs inside a fast-growing Series B startup, from purchase order to vendor payment to monthly close High ownership from day one, with real company spend rather than simulated exercises Fast-growing Series B startup (YC, Lightspeed, Nexus, General Catalyst, Battery-backed), scaling from ~50 to 100+ people Steep learning curve across bookkeeping, reconciliation, and monthly reporting, with direct exposure to leadership

title: Operations Intern
description: Clearwater Analytics' Managed Services team runs the day-to-day middle- and back-office operations — trade operations, NAV accounting, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting, for hedge funds and asset managers operating on the Enfusion platform. MS teams work inside a SOC 1 Type II control environment across break analysis & resolution, daily NAV production, trade affirmation using industry-standard platforms such as CTM, NYFIX, Traiana, and DTCC ALERT. As an intern on this team, you'll get first-hand exposure to how a fund's operations actually run behind the scenes. Responsibilities Reconciliation Support: assist in matching internal transaction records against custodian, broker, and bank statements, and help log discrepancies for the team to investigate. Data Entry & Validation: help record investor inflows, redemptions, corporate actions, and trade bookings accurately into the core portfolio accounting system (Enfusion). Trade Support: observe and support daily trade affirmation workflows across platforms including CTM, NYFIX, and Traiana. NAV & Reporting: shadow the daily NAV process & monthly trial balance reconciliation and help prepare operational reports. Records and reports the status of daily and monthly operational delivery. What You'll Gain Direct, hands-on exposure to how a real fund's middle and back office runs on a daily market cycle. Training on Enfusion and industry-standard platforms — CTM, NYFIX, Traiana, DTCC ALERT, and EMIR reporting tools. Mentorship from experienced fund operations professionals across reconciliation, NAV accounting, and trade lifecycle management. A front-row seat to how a SOC 1 Type II controlled operating environment is run in practice. Qualifications Education: Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Accounting, Business Management, or a related quantitative field. Certifications (Bonus): Progress toward CFA Level I, NISM, or another relevant local market certification is a plus, though not required. Hard Skills Strong Microsoft Excel skills — comfortable with VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and handling large data sets without errors. Basic understanding of financial statements, general ledger accounting, and how corporate actions (e.g., stock splits, dividends) affect fund valuations. Asset Classes: Intermediate understanding of fixed income and equity investments and a basic knowledge of alternative security types Strong accounting and/or finance skills. Familiarity with core operational concepts — how NAV is calculated daily, and the trade settlement lifecycle (e.g., clearing, custodian communication, T+1 settlement). Soft Skills Hyper-attention to detail — accuracy matters; a single misplaced decimal or swapped account number can cause real compliance and financial issues. Clear written and verbal communication for presenting findings and handling internal or client queries. Process orientation — able to follow structured SOPs precisely while spotting opportunities to improve them. Time management under pressure — comfortable working to firm daily market cut-off times. A proactive, eager-to-learn attitude toward new financial software and workflows.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Fraud (Crypto & Debit Card)
description: Job Summary This job will support the development and implementation of machine learning models that detect and prevent fraud across our Crypto and Debit Card portfolios. You will work alongside senior ML engineers, data scientists, software engineers, and fraud strategy teams to build and improve AI/ML solutions that protect customers and reduce losses. Your role will involve preparing data, building features, training and evaluating models, and helping deploy and monitor them in production. This is a great opportunity to grow your ML engineering skills on real-time systems that make high-impact decisions. Essential Responsibilities Assist in the development and optimization of machine learning models. Preprocess and analyze datasets to ensure data quality. Preprocess, clean, and analyze large transactional, behavioral, and device datasets to support model development. Build and test features under the guidance of senior engineers, such as transaction velocity and behavioral signals. Train, evaluate, and compare models using appropriate fraud metrics (precision, recall, false positive rates). Preferred Qualifications Internship or project experience in fraud detection, risk, anomaly detection, or payments. Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and big data tools such as Spark.
